name: button
title: Button
description: Primary, secondary, danger, and compact action buttons with disabled, hover, and focus states.

variants.name: primary
variants.description: Solid accent fill; the main action of a view.

variants.name: danger
variants.description: Destructive actions such as delete or revoke.

variants.name: small
variants.description: Compact type and padding for dense toolbars; keeps the 44px touch target.

docs: Use `data-uifa-variant` on the button element; omit it for the primary default. Disable with the native `disabled` attribute. Focus rings and hover shades derive from tokens, so no per-theme overrides are needed.
